title: Gray encounter in Catskills cabin with military and CIA observers

tellings.quote: and he sees all these military and intelligence people standing around.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says that the writer Whitley Strieber, author of Communion, a book about his encounters with strange beings, met a Gray, the small grey-skinned figure of many alien accounts, at his cabin in the Catskills in New York in the 1980s. As Jorjani retells it, Strieber saw military and intelligence people, including CIA officers, standing around watching. If true, it would mean the government knew about such encounters and observed them.
